Title: Auction House Sign Kit, 8 Signs for One Auction House: Bidder Register, Buyers Premium, Preview Hours, Pickup Deadline, Estate Sale Direction and More, 8x12 Rust-Resistant Aluminum, by CGAP Safety
Body (HTML):
The Auction House Sign Kit puts 8 signs in one order, every sign one auction house needs. Built for estate sale and auction house signs.

What is in the kit

  • Bidder Register: REGISTER TO BID / PHOTO ID REQUIRED
  • Buyers Premium: BUYERS PREMIUM / APPLIES TO ALL LOTS
  • Preview Hours: PREVIEW / FRIDAY 4 TO 7 PM
  • Pickup Deadline: PICK UP ITEMS / BY MONDAY NOON
  • As Is Auction: ALL ITEMS / SOLD AS IS
  • Estate Sale Direction: ESTATE SALE / THIS WAY
  • Fragile Lots: FRAGILE ITEMS / ASK FOR HELP
  • Auction Floor: AUCTION FLOOR

Each sign is 8x12 inch .065 aluminum with a rust-resistant, UV-resistant print and four pre-drilled corner holes. Made in the USA by CGAP Safety.
